items.name: Deck Crafter’s Collection
items.desc: Get ready to battle among the best with this collection of 40 tournament-staple cards, including Meowth ex! Whether you want to build a 60-card deck from scratch or simply power up the decks you already have, you can combine these essential Supporter, Item, and Pokémon Tool cards with cards from your own collection to create a strategy that's ready for everything from friendly matches to major tournaments on the Championship Series stage!
contents: A code card for Pokémon TCG Live

items.name: 30th Celebration Ditto Premium Collection
items.desc: Transform your celebration of 30 years of Pokémon into something delightfully unexpected with the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Ditto Premium Collection. The colorful acrylic display can be used to showcase the Ditto promo card or spotlight a new favorite from the eight 30th Celebration booster packs included in this set.
contents: A code card for Pokémon TCG Live

items.name: 30th Celebration Binder Collection
items.desc: Get ready to show off your favorite Pokémon TCG cards—including more to come—with the 30th Celebration Binder Collection. This 9-pocket binder features a design commemorating 30 years of Pokémon. To kick off the party, you also get a handful of booster packs from the special 30th Celebration expansion.

items.name: 30th Celebration Battle Deck—Espeon ex and 30th Celebration Battle Deck—Umbreon ex
items.desc: Powerful Pokémon ex are ready to charge onto the battlefield in the new Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Battle Decks! Each all-foil 60-card deck is led by an exceptional Pokémon ex and includes everything you need to play right away. Will you light up your day with Espeon ex or lurk in the nighttime shadows with Umbreon ex? Whichever deck you choose, you'll also discover an exclusive illustration rare-style promo card—Victini in the Espeon ex deck and Zeraora in the Umbreon ex deck. Let the battle begin!

items.name: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collections—Day & Night
items.desc:
Celebrate the adventurous past, exciting present, and brilliant future of the Pokémon Trading Card Game with a massive collection of cards, accessories, and fun in two 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collections—a day-themed set featuring Espeon ex and a night-themed set highlighting Umbreon ex. Each collection also includes a day- or night-themed Pikachu ex promo card illustrated by YOSHIROTTEN. These powerful Pokémon ex have invited lots of friends to their day out in the sun or their night out on stage—and you can join the festivities with the playmat, card sleeves, deck box, and other accessories in this collection.
To top it off, you also get 30 total booster packs featuring the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration expansion, including a special pack that contains three cards from the expansion's nostalgic Classic Collection!
contents: 1 foil promo card featuring Pikachu ex
1 foil promo card featuring Espeon ex or Umbreon ex
1 playmat featuring Pikachu, Espeon or Umbreon, and more
1 metal coin featuring Espeon or Umbreon
1 Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Classic Collection booster pack
A code card for Pokémon TCG Live

items.name: 30th Celebration Figure Collection
items.desc: Greet a new day with Mew or take on the night with Mewtwo in this sensational collection celebrating 30 years of Pokémon! In addition to a foil promo card and an oversize card featuring Mew or Mewtwo, you get a colorful sculpted figure of one of these elusive Pokémon, plus five booster packs from the special 30th Celebration expansion.
contents: 1 foil promo card featuring Mew or Mewtwo
1 oversize foil card featuring Mew or Mewtwo
